themes.description: Users repeatedly report that their withdrawal attempts fail, their funds are blocked or missing, and that customer support is unresponsive, slow, and lacks expertise, leading to frustration and abandonment of the platform.
themes.business_impact: Loss of user trust results in increased churn, negative reviews, potential regulatory scrutiny for a financial services app, and revenue decline as users migrate to competitors.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support system is understaffed or poorly organized, with insufficient escalation protocols, inadequate training on financial products, and high call volume that overwhelms available agents.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit current support staffing and SLA
• Implement priority queue for withdrawal and transaction issues
• Create dedicated support squad for financial product complaints
• Provide comprehensive training on bonds, mutual funds, and loan products
• Automate ticket escalation to higher tiers
• Deploy self‑service FAQ and live chat
• Monitor support metrics and publish weekly reports

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that the app fails to launch, crashes immediately upon opening, or displays a blank screen, preventing them from accessing any features.
themes.business_impact: Frequent launch failures lead to loss of user engagement, increased support tickets, and potential churn for the key financial data product, directly impacting revenue from premium subscriptions.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Likely a recent code or dependency update introduced a runtime exception or incompatibility on certain devices (e.g., Android 12+), causing early termination during app initialization. Possible issues include missing or misconfigured runtime permissions, corrupted cached data, or a misaligned native library.
themes.action_plan:
• Reproduce the crash on target devices
• Capture full stack trace via crash logs
• Review recent commits for changes in initialization or permission handling
• Add defensive coding for permission checks and fallback UI
• Update and publish hotfix with new crash handling
• Monitor crash metrics post-release

themes.name: [Negative] Scalper Mode Button Misplacement

quotes.text: not happy..After new update scalper option is given down that is very irritating every time. its getting pressed all the time.. pls change its position.
In the new update there is a button that is showing on positions. It should be removed from there because sometimes by mistake due to unwanted touch it may place order.

In the new update, as soon as I open the chart, my gesture buttons disappear, and right in that exact spot, they have placed a new button called 'Scalper mode'. If that button is pressed by mistake, the TradingView chart immediately switches to the Groww chart.

themes.description: Users report that the new UI places the Scalper Mode button in a location that is easily and unintentionally tapped, leading to accidental activations, unwanted order placement, or chart switching, which disrupts trading workflows.
themes.business_impact: The misplacement has led to a spike in negative reviews, increased user churn from the F&O segment, and a measurable decline in daily active trades due to frustration and perceived loss of control.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The recent update moved the Scalper Mode toggle to the bottom-left corner of chart screens, overlapping the back gesture area and other touch targets, without adequate testing for accidental taps or offering an option to hide it.
themes.action_plan: • Redesign the button placement to a less intrusive corner or side panel; add an optional toggle to hide the button; implement a long‑press confirmation dialog for accidental touches; conduct user testing with high‑frequency traders to validate tap ergonomics; roll out a quick patch via the app store; monitor post‑release metrics for repeat incidents.
